html:
Frosted window film can be used for both external and internal glass areas. Frosted privacy window film is great for adding privacy whilst maintaining natural light in areas like bathrooms or to add an element of style to your home or office with patterned frosted window film.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting – we have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. All films, exclusive to us are Government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality.

Frosted Privacy Window Film

Frosted glass window film is often used for bathroom windowsbut it is also a great option to partition off internal space or add privacy to internal glass-walled office spaces.

A glass wall with frosted privacy window film enables you to create private internal space whilst still maintaining an element of openness.

Patterned Frosted Window Film

Patterned frosted window film is a great alternative to having a plain block of frosted privacy window film.

It adds an element of style or a unique feature to a room.

We have a range of frosted window film designs to choose from and you can also customise a design.

This is a popular option for office spaces as you can add your company logo or branding.

When you have our frosted glass window film installed you can benefit from:

  • Installations are done by professionally trained installers
  • A lifetime warranty on residential applications and up to 15 years for commercial applications
  • Interest-free payment plans

Frosted Glass Window Film

We use digital graphics and computer-cut technology on our frosted glass film to create unique designs to add style and a unique edge to your home or office. Because we can customise designs, you can also incorporate your branding if you are having frosted glass film applied in your office space.

Frosted glass window film is not only fantastic for privacy without losing natural light but is also great to use internally too. Frosted privacy window film can be used as a divider in a room and is great to use in kids rooms to add a fun element that can be removed or updated as your children grow.

Why Choose Our Frosted Privacy Window Film?

In addition to adding privacy and style to your home or office with frosted film, here some of the other benefits of choosing our frosted privacy window film:

  • Heat and glare are reduced
  • Your home or office will be safer and more secure
  • All our films are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality
  • We offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications and up to 15 years for commercial applications
  • We offer zero-interest payment plans
  • All films are installed by professionally trained installers
